tasks.short: Plan and lay out a repair

steps.what: Read current diagrams, blueprints and maintenance manuals for the repair
Inspect and measure the actual repair location against the diagrams
Plan the repair sequence, access and necessary resources
Draw and check the actual repair layout and working sequence

tasks.design: Link released drawings and manuals to the asset in {OPS_SYSTEM} and reuse standard drawing symbols in the layout tool {OTHER}. The worker inspects the actual location, selects the repair approach and checks the working layout against measurements.
tasks.previous_blocker: References are retrieved separately and standard layout elements are redrawn.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset links and drawing symbol libraries remove navigation and repetitive drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Actual clearances, isolation needs and damaged components can differ from the drawing.
tasks.human_edge: Connect the plan with the physical installation and identify when engineering input is necessary.

ambition.what: The worker retains the same repair planning authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked manuals and reusable drawing symbols can reduce repair-plan retrieval and drafting without deciding a safe repair method.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual working layout used during the repair. It does not authorize execution, isolation, engineering modifications or equipment release; their existing permit and approval routes remain distinct actions.

Engineering maintains asset id, drawing id, revision and released manuals. The worker produces actual measurements in s2 and enters them in the layout in s4; no pre-existing clean measurement model is assumed. OTHER means measuring tools in s2 and the existing drawing tool in s4.

s1 removes three units of repeated reference navigation. s4 removes five units of standard symbol drawing, retaining twenty for actual dimensions, repair-specific layout and verification. Missing or incompatible drawing elements remain manual with repair upkeep funded below.
The ordinary save within s4 is negligible, unchanged and ungated. Native libraries already in use earn no new benefit. Shares are illustrative rather than measured.
unknowns: Whether asset links and symbol libraries already exist
How often drawings match the installed equipment
research_questions: Can reused layout elements preserve correct dimensions and current revisions?

already_counted.description: Read actual references, inspect the location, choose the approach and complete the layout

incremental.description: Repair stale asset links and incompatible drawing symbols

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R92 gross8 less upkeep2 gives6. For a legacy installation with no reusable layout elements, retrieval retains18 of20 and layout25 of25; inspection25 and planning30 stay. R98 gross2 less upkeep2 gives0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train maintenance personnel in actual practice

steps.what: Read the current maintenance procedure for the personnel training
Train maintenance personnel or subcontractors, observe practice and correct technique

tasks.design: Configure direct asset links to the released maintenance procedure in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. The worker still demonstrates the method, observes the trainee and gives feedback in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: The correct procedure sometimes requires a document search before instruction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing asset-document links can remove that search.
tasks.still_hard: A trainee's competence and understanding must be seen in actual practice.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a hazardous misunderstanding and adapt the explanation to the learner.

ambition.what: Practical instruction and supervision remain the worker's duty.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked maintenance procedures can shorten reference search; hands-on instruction and supervision remain human.

assumptions: Representative episode is practical on-the-job training, not formal certification or subcontractor dispatch. No completion record is invented where none is kept; an operation requiring actual qualification entry must add that real record and authority before extending this estimate.

The procedure owner maintains asset id, procedure id and released revision. The trainer reads the original document where a link is missing. No new performance-monitoring dataset or recording is introduced.

Two of ten reference units are document navigation; eight remain for reading and matching the actual procedure. Native access already available earns no new benefit. Physical instruction retains ninety units.
unknowns: Whether current procedure links already remove search
Whether the actual episode includes certification paperwork
research_questions: Does linking the reference improve access without shortening necessary procedure reading?

already_counted.description: Read the actual reference and train personnel through observed practice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R98 gross2 less upkeep0.5 gives1.5. For an unfamiliar subcontractor procedure requiring the original source, reference work retains9.5 of10; gross0.5 less upkeep0.5 gives0, with instruction unchanged.

role.altitude: The worker keeps physical inspection, repair judgement and practical training, with less reference search and repetitive layout drawing.
role.ambitious_version: Prepare accurate working layouts with more attention available for actual installation differences.
